title: Python test/lint/typecheck commands (tox in pyproject, run via uv)
answers: How do I run Python tests in mitmproxy?
How to run a single test file?
What linters and type checkers does mitmproxy use?
body:
- No tox.ini: tox is configured in `pyproject.toml` `[tool.tox]` (env_list = lint, mypy, py; runner uv-venv-lock-runner, dependency group `dev`). AGENTS.md says use `uv` for everything.
- All: `uv run tox`; tests only: `uv run tox -e py` (pytest -vv --cov=mitmproxy --cov=release, default `--timeout 60`).
- Single file: `uv run pytest test/mitmproxy/test_http.py[::test_name]` (or `-k expr`).
- Pytest config `[tool.pytest.ini_options]`: testpaths=test, asyncio_mode=auto, RuntimeWarning and PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning are errors.
- Other envs: `test-offline` (test/run-tests-offline.sh), `filename_matching` (test/filename_matching.py), `individual_coverage -- FILE` (test/individual_coverage.py; AGENTS.md asks for it on new source files; exclusions in `[tool.pytest.individual_coverage]`).
- Lint: `uv run tox -e lint` = `ruff check .` (rules E,F,I force-single-line,TID251; contrib excluded). Autofix/format: `uv run tox -e fix`.
- Types: `uv run tox -e mypy` (files: mitmproxy, examples/addons, release/*.py; check_untyped_defs).
- Note: agent only read configs, did not execute these.
